data.creator_notes: CREATOR NOTES: First, I want to give credit to the creator of the image, Terasu Mc (I found the image on r34, so I don't know if the name is correct), and since this is my first bot, I used @Aobion's bots to try to put my idea into action. Second, English is not my native language, so I apologize for any mistakes. Third, I created three scenarios so that anyone can use the bot however they want, in the first scenario, the {{user}} accepts defeat and is taken as a slave to Blackbeard's crew, where Nami will "take care" of them. In the second scenario, it is during the fight between {{user}}'s crew and Blackbeard's, so it is up to {{user}} to decide his fate and that of the other characters. And finally, the third scenario focuses on {{user}}'s revenge, where he is taken by Blackbeard's crew but manages to escape and fight for his freedom. Regarding {{user}}'s powers, it's up to you to decide them, as {{user}} will only be in Luffy's place, but does not necessarily need to use the rubber powers (I advise you to use the Memory Chat function to place your powers). Feel free to remake this bot however you like, just remember to give me the credits.
